character.name: Sankta Miksaparato
character.description: Blocks 3 enemies and attacks from long range.
character.itemUsage: Gun-Knight Sankta Miksaparato, always fond of heading where it's liveliest.
character.itemDesc: Yes, that gentleman with his hands behind his back watching the younger operators tread on shadows is him.

candidates.name: Machine-Gun Welcome Ceremony
candidates.description: Whenever Sankta Miksaparato deals damage, he gains DEF +20 and ASPD +2 for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times

candidates.name: Machine-Gun Welcome Ceremony
candidates.description: Whenever Sankta Miksaparato deals damage, he gains DEF +30 and ASPD +3 for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times

candidates.name: Shield-Up Farewell Ceremony
candidates.description: When Sankta Miksaparato has not attacked for 8 seconds, he gains a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to 15% Max HP; this timer restarts once the Barrier is lost

candidates.name: Shield-Up Farewell Ceremony
